d: The INDIA bloc is stepping up its protest against alleged discrepancies in the SIR exercise. Leaders from 21 opposition parties gathered at Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge’s 10 Rajaji Marg residence in New Delhi for a mock Parliament session, where he read out an “impeachment motion” against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The gathering comes ahead of the INDIA bloc’s 1 November rally at Ramlila Maidan, where several civil society groups are also expected to participate.
